    Profile

    Rochelle is a young girl with a unique way of speaking that identifies herself as a black and white bear. Spotted by the band of thieves, the Unicorn Knights, she has a special ability to sense the essense of others, but cannot say whether the subjects are of good or evil. She doesn't label others as either black or white since she only sees things in a positive light.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Female
    Height: 153cm
    Weight: 44kg
    Birthday: Oct 15
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Fiery Imperial Skies
    Likes: Taking naps, black & white
    Hobbies: To become round
    Illust: あやっぺ隊長
    CV: 高木遥香
